d:
THe YRP (Yuna, Rikku, Paine) are doing what they do best, which is kick ass and look for treasure, but when it seems like another victory as usual, leader Yuna starts to act abnormally, influenced by the spirit within the Berserker DressSphere she is channeling...

A crossover between Final Fantasy 10 and Fighting Layer, an AU where Sphere Hunters do not exist but instead it is Bounty Hunters, ending in a dire bad ending for the heroines.
n: [Misc] FINAL FANTASY X - Ignition of Berserker Yuna [AI GENERATED]
